hero.title: Capturing moments you'll cherish forever
hero.descriptionP1: We believe every precious moment deserves to be remembered. NORA is an event photobooth service that doesn't just print photos instantly, but also captures every smile, laugh, and shared moment in high-quality photos.
hero.descriptionP2: NORA accompanies weddings, engagements, birthdays, and various other special events.

features.title: Make Your Moments More Memorable
features.description: We combine technology, creativity, and a personal touch so every guest has a story to take home.

frameTemplates.title: Beautiful Templates, Fully Customizable
frameTemplates.description: Choose from elegant, event-ready designs. We'll adjust the text and colors to match your event theme.
frameTemplates.requestMessage: Hi, I'd like to request a custom photobooth frame design.

packages.title: Choose the Package That Fits Your Event
packages.description: Every package can be tailored further — tell us what you need and we'll help put together the right package.
packages.waMessage: Hi Nora Photobooth, I'd like to ask about your photobooth packages.

features: Custom backdrop to match your theme

gallery.title: A Glimpse of the Fun in Every Shot
gallery.description: Snapshots of the photobooth atmosphere from the many receptions we've been part of.

testimonials.title: Stories from the events we've been part of

sarahBima.quote: Our guests kept lining up at the booth because it was so much fun! The prints turned out beautiful too, matching our decor perfectly.

dindaRaka.quote: The Nora team was super responsive from the first consultation to the big day. The props were adorable, and the photo templates could be customized to our request.

putriAldi.quote: Totally worth it as a keepsake for our guests. Prints came out fast, the results looked great, and the online gallery made it easy for us to share photos.

footer.tagline: Accompanying your happy day with an elegant, fun, and memorable photo session.

photoboothFrames.helpText: Different from the "Frame Template" on the landing page. This frame is used in the "Try Digital Photobooth" feature — upload a transparent PNG, then set the number, size, and position of the photo boxes exactly over the transparent cutouts in the image below. The number of boxes determines how many photos the guest will take.
